name: cguhacks2026
description: Drayline: port-to-warehouse dispatch decision support (CGU Hackathon 2026, GeoAI track)

scripts.dev:backend: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; cd backend && python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port $BACKEND_PORT --reload
scripts.dev:frontend: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --port $FRONTEND_PORT --strictPort
scripts.seed: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; curl -fsS -X POST http://localhost:$BACKEND_PORT/api/reset >/dev/null && echo 'board reset to the normal day' || echo 'backend not running: seed data loads from backend/data when it starts'
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
